Giancarlo Martini (16 August 1947 – 26 March 2013) [ 1 ] was a

Everest Ferrari 312T in the 1976 BRDC International Trophy race at Silverstone . Giancarlo Martini (16 August 1947 – 26 March 2013) [ 1 ] was a racing driver from Italy . He participated in two non-championship Formula One Grands Prix driving a Ferrari 312T for Giancarlo Minardi . He was the uncle of the racing drivers Pierluigi Martini and Oliver Martini .
